notes: Align H / Align V now touch one axis only. Before, if you'd dragged the main text (e.g. moved it up into a free position), clicking 'Center horizontally' also threw away your vertical position and snapped the text back to the middle — and vice-versa for 'Center vertically'. Now each button keeps the other axis exactly where you put it, matching what the tooltips already promised. Also rolls in the v1.5.1 fix: updating no longer opens a duplicate browser tab.
